about: Split calls from the first look of wave 19.

listings.note: Four places on both sides of the river: the K row, the A and B loops, the C loop and the D spur, over a kilometer.
Five arms of the lake over 1.5 km, each with its own lane and sites.
Four points of the lake over 1.5 km, each with its own lanes.
Four clusters over 1.2 km of lake: the A point, the O point, the H loop and the M and B loops.
Four fingers of the lake over 1.2 km, each with its own lane.
The B, L, W and S points and two group camps, spread over 1.5 km of lake.
The north cluster (079 to 098) sits 1 km from the point and south loops.
The A, B, C, K, D and E areas, spread over 1.4 km of shore.
